id: title:fivestarspicy:tier name experiment for scanner model picker

review.posthog_relevance: Adds frontend support and feature flagging for a tier-naming experiment in the Replay Vision scanner, including snapshot registration and conditional label rendering.
review.reason: The chunk adds snapshot entries for tier-named model variants, a new feature flag, and frontend wiring to display tier names conditionally. This is a narrow, localized implementation supporting an experiment rather than a systemic capability or critical reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the backend tier assignment and model label implementation, so the complete tier-dependent behavior and its actual benefit are not demonstrated in this code.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the tier-naming experiment, the backend model tier assignment, or the complete modelLabel and getModelOptions functions. It only includes the snapshot registration, the feature flag, the UI wiring, and the tests.
